fabrication.title: Folding seats: locks, guards and floor connections
fabrication.available: Captive lock pins, separate spring cotters, front handholds, hinge covers and a folding rear curtain are drawn as individual parts. Reinforced rail ends and the complete proposed bolt stack connect the seats to the underframe.
fabrication.connection: Actual pin guides, cotters, covers, curtain clamps, foot stack, weld details and eight reinforced rail-end collars.
fabrication.hold: Retainer strength, tolerant fits, flexible guarding, joint contact/prying, fatigue, weld procedures and physical prototype acceptance remain open.

fabrication.title: Accessible coach: side doorway and boarding
fabrication.available: The accessible entrance is a side doorway into the front turning area: a 42-inch structural opening with a 36-inch clear boarding passage between the low edge hardware and bridge curbs. A removable station bridge connects the platform to the coach; the two wheelchair bays remain inside the coach.
fabrication.connection: Physical side-door frame/leaf, hinges and latches, pinned bridge and handrails, dock parts, track backing and shoulder-post roots.
fabrication.hold: Bridge near-end connection strength, actual station geometry, door forces, restraint-system qualification, OEM fitting dimensions and actual-device maneuvering remain open.

fabrication.title: Sprung passenger-coach trucks
fabrication.available: Physical wheel and axle blanks, bearing housings, guided axleboxes, coil seats, retention, frame welds and body-support connections replace the earlier truck display shapes. Regular and accessible coaches use separate spring free lengths.
fabrication.connection: Guided axleboxes, retained coils, bearing covers, frame/guide welds, spherical body bearing, kingpin, sidebearer tracks and custom brake-support interfaces.
fabrication.hold: Actual mass and CG, coupled support stability, pad/spring vendor characteristics, axle/wheel fits and fatigue, brake mating details and complete operating envelope remain open.

fabrication.title: C2.1 braced benches
fabrication.available: Four drawings, physical 3D, STEP/DXF, part list and stiffness/mass comparisons.
fabrication.connection: Four-bolt steel bypass with compact ribbed plates; 1.25in square braces.
fabrication.hold: Local contact/weld/rail-wall and fatigue checks, positive locking, actual service tools, panel fastening, finishes and tests.

fabrication.title: Regular coach body · C1
fabrication.available: Physical hollow wall/roof members, window apertures, sheet and door-leaf geometry; J01 plates, sleeves and drilling coordinates; STEP and editable source.
fabrication.connection: C1-J01 direct post/frame bracket is a proposed physical connection, with separate upper/lower force couples. Candidate A500 C tubes, A36 plates and aluminum enclosure sheets.
fabrication.hold: Not yet a complete coach. Joint local wall/contact/bolt/weld/fatigue, roof closure and skin retention, real benches/floor mounts, doors/windows, trucks/brakes, stairs/couplings and HVAC installation need further design/review.
